column3: BSB renders “giving heed to” as “to follow.”
BSB adds “influenced by” and “with a hot iron.”
BSB adds “certain” and “require”; the Greek has only “to abstain from foods.”
BSB renders “the good teaching” as “sound instruction” and “closely followed” as “followed.”
BSB renders “profane and old-wives’ fables” as “irreverent, silly myths.”
BSB renders “profitable for a little” as “of limited value” and “for everything” as “in every way.”
BSB follows the critical text with “strive” (ἀγωνιζόμεθα); the Textus Receptus reads “suffer reproach.” “Set our hope” renders “have hoped.”
BSB follows the critical text without “in spirit,” which appears in the Textus Receptus; “set an example” renders “be a pattern.”
Close to the Greek; “be diligent in” renders “ponder.”
